header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: “One day, at the time of the Fajr Salah, when the Prophet ﷺ left Hazrat Juwairiyah (RA), she was sitting at her place of Salah (doing Dhikr). When the Prophet ﷺ came back after praying Duha, she was still sitting in the same state. When the Prophet ﷺ asked, “Are you sitting in the same state in which I left you?' she said, “Yes.” (He said,) “After I left you, I said four Kalimahs three times. If those Kalimahs were weighed against what you have recited from the morning until now, those Kalimahs would be heavier. (سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ) I glorify Allah as much as the number of His creations, as much as His pleasure, as much as the weight of His Arsh, and as much as the ink for writing His words.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ﵁ أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ عَلَي امْرَأَةٍ وَّبَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا نَوًي أَوْ حَصًي تُسَبِّحُ بِهِ فَقَالَ: أُخْبِرُكِ بِمَا هُوَ أَيْسَرُ عَلَيْكِ مِنْ هَذَا أَوْ أَفْضَلُ؟ فَقَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي اْلاَرْضِ وسُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ بَيْنَ ذلِكَ وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ مِثْلَ ذلِكَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ مِثْلَ ذلِكَ وَلَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ مِثْلَ ذلِكَ وَلَاحَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ مِثْلَ ذلِكَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب التسبيح بالحصي رقم:١٥٠٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (RA) says, “I went with the Prophet ﷺ to a Sahabi woman. She was reciting Tasbih with date stones or small pebbles.” ”I will tell you some Kalimahs which are much easier and better than this deed which you are doing,” said the Prophet ﷺ, and he taught her the following Kalimahs
